turns.text: Sure! When using condoms to prevent sexually transmitted infections (STIs), it’s important to ensure they are used consistently and correctly. Put on a new condom each time you have sex, use water-based lubricants, and check for any damage before use. Remove the condom carefully after ejaculation and dispose of it properly. This helps reduce the risk of transmitting STIs.
